flows.name: An AI analyst triages a security detection, and the team decides (Charlotte AI)
flows.summary: CrowdStrike's page: Charlotte AI "reasons, decides, and acts at machine speed", but its FAQ is precise about the limits: by default its prebuilt agents only generate information, summaries and recommendations, and any action that affects the environment needs explicit configuration and approval by an authorised member of the security team.

steps.what: Evaluates the detection (Detection Triage) and produces a verdict, a confidence score, a recommendation and an explanation of its reasoning; CrowdStrike reports over 98% agreement with its own managed-detection team's decisions.
steps.agent: Triages, enriches and does routine investigation steps.

steps.what: Decides whether to escalate, close or route the detection, on its own criteria and configured playbooks.
Configures, in Charlotte AI AgentWorks, which agent actions run automatically and which need a person's review before they run.

Acts on the environment only where that has been configured and approved; every run sits inside role-based permissions, execution traces, audit logs, agent version history and rollback, and credit caps.
steps.agent: Takes the actions it has been granted.
